CheckTitle: Ensure Location-Based Access Control (LBAC) is enabled
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Description: LBAC restricts Fusion UI and API sign-ins to registered IP ranges; other networks get only limited access.
Risk: Valid credentials can otherwise be used from untrusted networks.
AuditProcedure: Security Console > Location Based Access: 'Enable Location Based Access' is selected with valid allowlist entries.
IT Security Manager role is public to avoid lockout; test from allowed and disallowed IPs.

Steps: Enable LBAC, add trusted ranges (including the administrator's IP), mark IT Security Manager as public and test.
